name: Yuuri
source: A commoner citizen of Kanto. She found Shin in the aftermath of battle with Kurokami and becomes Shin's vassal following the order of Haru. Since she respects and admires the Eight Swords (top position in Kanto with responsibility to lead and protect people), she hates Shin because he joins the rank just from the declaration of Haru again for no apparent reason.
